sections.title: Expressing Firm Conviction
sections.content: When defending an argument with confidence, speakers deploy modal disjuncts such as *kétségkívül* (undoubtedly), *minden bizonnyal* (in all probability / most certainly), *nyilvánvalóan* (obviously), and *vitathatatlanul* (indisputably).

items.spanish: Kétségkívül ez volt az elmúlt évek legfontosabb döntése.
items.english: Undoubtedly this was the most important decision of recent years.

items.spanish: Vitathatatlanul szükség van a strukturális reformokra.
items.english: There is indisputably a need for structural reforms.

items.spanish: Minden bizonnyal pozitív hatással lesz a gazdaságra.
items.english: In all probability it will exert a positive impact on the economy.
